actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

facts.text: The repository is connected to the paper 'Towards Latency Efficient DRL Inference: Improving UAV Obstacle Avoidance at the Edge Through Model Compression'
The setup clones the external decargroup/ifo_gazebo Gazebo model and PX4-Autopilot workspace
The setup clones the external troiwill/mavros-px4-vehicle package, which communicates with the PX4 autopilot through MAVROS
The README instructs copying six Python scripts by hand into the mavros-px4-vehicle catkin package's scripts directory
The environment imports rospy, sensor_msgs, geometry_msgs, std_srvs, cv_bridge and cv2, and imports PX4_MODE_OFFBOARD, SetPositionWithYawCmdBuilder and PX4Vehicle from mavros_px4_vehicle
The constructor creates PX4Vehicle(auto_connect=True)
The constructor creates the /gazebo pause and unpause service proxies and subscribes to /camera/depth/image_raw and /mavros/local_position/pose
The environment registers DroneGymGazeboEnv-v0 with entry point new_drone_gym_gazebo_env:DroneGymGazeboEnv and max_episode_steps 225
DroneGymGazeboEnv derives from gymnasium.Env
The action space is spaces.Discrete(3), commented as three actions forward/left/right
The observation space is spaces.Box(low=-1.0, high=8.0, shape=(3, 80, 106), dtype=np.float32)
The start point is (0.0, 0.0, 1.5) and the desired point is (7.0, start.y, 1.5)
The workspace bounds are x in (-0.5, 7.5], y in (-1.7, 1.7] relative to start_point.y and z in (0.5, 3.2]
The goal reward is 100, speed is 0.5 m/s, action_duration is 0.5 s and the candidate y start/desired points are 0.0, -5.0, -10.0 and -15.0
step unpauses Gazebo, applies the action, pauses Gazebo and returns (observation, reward, terminated, False, {})
reset takes options then seed and calls random.seed(seed) when a seed is given

When the drone is not armed (commented as the first call of reset) reset unpauses Gazebo, arms the drone, goes to takeoff height and sets offboard mode; otherwise it draws the start y with np.random.choice(self.possible_y_start_desired_points)

The other reset branch unpauses Gazebo, sends the drone to x-0.5, then up to work_space_z_max + 1.0, then to the start point x and y at that height, with rospy.sleep waits of 8, 4 and 8 s, goes to takeoff height and pauses Gazebo
reset ends by calling reset_dist_to_desired_point_and_observations and returning _get_obs()
forward and left_or_right read the current pose and send a set_pose2d setpoint offset by round(self.speed, 2) in x, or by direction * speed in y, at start_point.z
unpause_sim and pause_sim wait for the Gazebo service with rospy.wait_for_service and only print a failed call
The constructor's readiness checks retry rospy.wait_for_message with a 5 s timeout until a depth image and a pose arrive or ROS shuts down
_set_action maps 0 to forward, 1 to left_or_right(1) and 2 to left_or_right(-1), holding each action for action_duration seconds
_get_obs writes desired.x - x and desired.y - y into the position channel and concatenates the current depth image, the previous depth image and that position map
is_in_desired_position defaults epsilon to 0.5 and tests x and y against desired +/- epsilon
is_inside_workspace tests the absolute x and z bounds and the y bounds offset by start_point.y
drone_has_collided treats roll outside (-0.2, 0.2], pitch outside (-0.2, 0.2] or yaw outside (-0.05, 0.05] as a collision
_is_done terminates when the drone leaves the workspace, collides or reaches the desired position
_compute_reward returns -1 plus the reduction in distance while the episode runs, goal_reward when it ends at the desired position and -goal_reward otherwise
close shuts down the ROS node with rospy.signal_shutdown
The step2 copy registers the same DroneGymGazeboEnv-v0 id with entry point eval_drone_gym_gazebo_env:DroneGymGazeboEnv
The step2 reset selects the start y with a counter that cycles through the four candidate points
The step2 goal test defaults epsilon to 0.7

determinism.notes: the fake seeds a local random.Random with the reset seed and uses it for the start-y choice of resets after the first; that choice is not visible in its observation, which is relative to the chosen lane. The upstream reset calls random.seed(seed) but draws the start y with np.random.choice (step1:103-104, :120), which that seed does not reach, so the upstream reset is not seed-controlled and no trajectory was compared with it

gaps: the fake is an analytic kinematic setpoint model: it loads no ROS, Gazebo, PX4 SITL, MAVROS, ifo_gazebo or mavros_px4_vehicle code, runs no physics, contacts, attitude, depth camera, CvBridge or OpenCV preprocessing, and holds no actuator, sensor or noise model

the real observation is spaces.Box(low=-1.0, high=8.0, shape=(3, 80, 106), dtype=np.float32) (step1:41-45); the fake declares and returns a 3 x 8 x 8 placeholder array whose first two channels are zeros and whose last channel carries only desired.x - x and desired.y - y (step1:294-305) so receipts stay bounded

one fake step is one discrete setpoint transition of 0.5 m (step1:67-68, :233-251); the upstream step unpauses Gazebo, holds the command for action_duration 0.5 s and pauses it again (step1:83-92, :253-273), so the fake models no dynamics over that interval and no wall-clock pacing
collision termination is not modelled: the upstream derives it from the pose quaternion's roll/pitch/yaw (step1:350-369), while the fake keeps attitude zero and never reports a collision

the upstream reset arms the drone, waits for arming, sets offboard mode and sends several setpoints with rospy.sleep waits (step1:106-150); the fake performs an instantaneous state jump and models only the resulting start position

the first reset starts at y=0 and later resets choose from the four candidate y points and start the drone in that lane (step1:120, :144-149); the step2 copy cycles those candidates with a counter and defaults the goal epsilon to 0.7 (step2:120-126, :312), while this package serves the step1 copy

the position channel holds desired.y - y, which reaches about -1.7 inside the workspace, below the declared observation low of -1.0 (step1:45, :57-63, :296-297); the bridge does not check observations against the Box, and the fake returns such values too

the registration's max_episode_steps 225 is applied by gymnasium.make's TimeLimit wrapper; the upstream env.step itself always returns truncated=False (step1:92), and the fake implements the 225-step truncation directly because the bridge serves the pre-built fake
no snapshot and restore: DroneGymGazeboEnv defines no get_state or set_state method

no live environment backend is included: the upstream needs ROS Noetic, Gazebo, PX4 SITL and two external catkin packages, and its scripts are copied by hand rather than installed (README.md:20-24, :79-83, :103-109), so runtime construction was not attempted

live construction and lifecycle hazards (model review): the class never calls rospy.init_node (its training script does, step1/train_main_d3qn.py:38); the constructor connects PX4Vehicle (auto_connect=True) and waits without a bound for the Gazebo services and for a depth image and a pose (step1:36, :73-80, :166-200); reset arms the drone and switches it to OFFBOARD (step1:106-118); close calls rospy.signal_shutdown for the whole process (step1:162-164); failed pause/unpause calls and CvBridge errors are printed to stdout (step1:171, :178, :279), which would corrupt a stdio server

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the runtime latches the e-stop and accepts no step or reset until mhs.safety.reset clears it; the fake holds its last observation and tick, and the latch does not disarm the vehicle or clear the PX4Vehicle.set_pose2d setpoint, so a physical PX4 on that MAVROS link is not stopped. A completed step or reset pauses Gazebo only when /gazebo/pause_physics succeeds; a failed pause is only printed, and a running step or reset is not interrupted
